# DSH Studio v0.7.6

这是一次针对 [#4](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/4) 的 macOS 兼容性与桌面体验
修复版本。它升级并锁定完整的 Harness rc.2 运行时，修复本地插件详情 404、图形界面 PATH、
终端复制滚动、错误日志着色和布局溢出，并把 macOS 菜单换成真正有用的应用操作。

## 新增

- macOS 应用菜单新增「检查更新」和「重新启动 DSH Studio」，同时保留标准编辑、窗口、隐藏与
  退出操作。
- 内置终端新增复制、粘贴和清空按钮；macOS 使用 `⌘C / ⌘V`，Windows/Linux 使用
  `Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V`，终端滚动条始终可用。

## 变更与安全

- Harness 升级到 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`；在线安装、离线包和运行时验证继续使用同一份
  完整锁文件，避免顶层 rc.2 与传递依赖旧版本混装。pnpm 仍固定为 11.7.0。
- macOS/Linux 终端从登录 Shell 恢复经过白名单过滤的 PATH，不导入令牌、密钥等凭据变量。
- 已安装的本地 `link:`、文件和 Git 插件直接显示 Profile 中的已验证信息，不向 npm registry
  发送无意义的详情请求，也不会因此制造 404。
- macOS 默认 File / View / Help 菜单被精简为应用、编辑与窗口菜单；检查更新复用现有的签名
  更新流程，重新启动使用受控的 Tauri 应用重启。

## 修复与打磨

- 修复 [#4](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/4)：Harness 已可用时，macOS 不再因
  缺少全局 pnpm 显示错误警告；Studio 会复用自身工具目录或托管 Harness 中版本完全匹配的 pnpm。
- 修复点击已安装本地/Git 插件后错误查询 npm registry 并显示 HTTP 404。
- 修复从 Finder/Dock 启动时 GUI PATH 缺少 `claude`、`starship` 等登录 Shell 工具，进而触发
  Powerlevel10k 警告或命令不可用。
- 修复终端难以选择、复制、粘贴和滚动的问题，同时保留 Windows/Linux 的 `Ctrl+C` 中断语义。
- npm cache、解析进度和普通信息不再因为写入 stderr 就全部显示红色；警告、错误和普通输出
  现在按内容分级。
- 启动失败提示增加宽度边界、自动换行和内部滚动，不再把右侧工作区挤出窗口。

## 安装与更新

建议所有 macOS 用户，以及使用本地/Git 插件或遇到终端 PATH、复制、滚动和日志显示问题的
用户升级。现有 `~/.dsh` Profile、插件、工作区、会话和凭据都会保留；Harness 会按锁定合同
升级到 rc.2。

请使用 `SHA256SUMS.txt` 核对下载；应用内更新继续强制验证 Tauri 更新签名。Windows
Authenticode 与 Apple Developer ID 是独立的操作系统发布者签名，取决于发布仓库配置的凭据。

[英文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.6/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.6/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [比较 v0.7.5...v0.7.6](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.7.5...v0.7.6)

<!-- dsh-notes:en -->
# DSH Studio v0.7.6

This patch release addresses the macOS compatibility and desktop usability
problems reported in [#4](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/4). It
ships a fully locked Harness rc.2 runtime, fixes local-plugin detail 404s, GUI
PATH recovery, terminal clipboard and scrolling, log severity and layout
overflow, and replaces the macOS menu with useful application actions.

## Added

- The macOS application menu now offers Check for Updates and Restart DSH
  Studio while retaining standard edit, window, hide and quit commands.
- The embedded terminal adds copy, paste and clear buttons. macOS uses
  `⌘C / ⌘V`; Windows/Linux use `Ctrl+Shift+C / Ctrl+Shift+V`, and the scroll lane
  remains available.

## Changed and secured

- Harness is upgraded to `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`. Online setup, offline
  payloads and runtime verification share one complete lock, preventing a top-
  level rc.2 package from being mixed with older transitive DSH packages. pnpm
  remains pinned to 11.7.0.
- macOS/Linux terminals recover a credential-filtered PATH from the login shell;
  tokens, keys and other credential variables are not imported.
- Installed local `link:`, file and Git plugins display verified profile metadata
  directly instead of issuing an irrelevant npm registry detail request and
  manufacturing a 404.
- The default macOS File / View / Help menus are replaced by focused application,
  edit and window menus. Update checks reuse the signed updater flow, while
  restart uses Tauri's controlled application restart.

## Fixed and polished

- Fixed [#4](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/issues/4): an available
  Harness on macOS no longer produces a missing-package-manager warning merely
  because pnpm is not global. Studio reuses an exact pnpm match from its tools or
  managed Harness directory.
- Fixed installed local/Git plugin details querying npm and ending in HTTP 404.
- Fixed Finder/Dock launches losing login-shell tools such as `claude` and
  `starship`, which could also trigger a Powerlevel10k warning.
- Fixed terminal selection, copy, paste and scrolling without stealing ordinary
  `Ctrl+C` interrupt semantics on Windows/Linux.
- npm cache, resolution progress and ordinary information are no longer painted
  red merely because npm writes them to stderr; warnings and actual errors remain
  distinct.
- Startup failure details are bounded, wrapped and internally scrollable so the
  workspace can no longer be pushed out of the window.

## Install and update

All macOS users, local/Git plugin users, and anyone affected by terminal PATH,
clipboard, scrolling or log-display problems should upgrade. Existing `~/.dsh`
profiles, plugins, workspaces, sessions and credentials are preserved while the
managed Harness moves to the locked rc.2 contract.

Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`; in-app updates continue to require the
Tauri updater signature. Windows Authenticode and Apple Developer ID are
separate OS publisher signatures and depend on credentials configured for the
release repository.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.6/CHANGELOG.md) · [中文更新日志](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/blob/v0.7.6/CHANGELOG.zh-CN.md) · [Compare v0.7.5...v0.7.6](https://github.com/Moresyl/dsh-studio/compare/v0.7.5...v0.7.6)

<!-- dsh-notes:end -->
